text:
alex: quick sync — PR #42816 modifies gRPC connection pooling and the controlled batching knobs. planning to land Tue 09:00 PT (low-traffic window). need runtime + infra + security approvals before merge. cc @mira @raj @tasha

mira: on it. can you paste the cli to reproduce perf locally? i want to run a 50k token/min sim.

alex: sure — run against staging with this: `./scripts/loadtest --target staging-grpc --qps 200 --seq 256`

raj: FYI the patch toggles a kernel-level bpf eviction hint flag in infra/eviction.c — i'll need to validate on prod-ish nodes. can we gate rollout to subset of regions?

alex: yes — rollout plan attached inline: region slice = [us-west-2, us-east-1], 10% traffic for 30m, check token latency P95 and 5xx rate. abort if P95 increases > 20ms or 5xx > 0.5% over baseline.

tasha: security quick question — the grpc proxy change reorders auth header surface. did you keep header canonicalization? need reasoning for the order change and a short threat note. also request a minimal unit test for the header case.

alex: added a short note at the top of PR and a unit test under platform/tests/test_auth_order.py. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/42816/files

jong: platform: please confirm routing fallback is intact if new pooling runs out of connections. what's behavior for short-lived spikes?

mira: initial perf glance — under the reproduce cmd i ran, P50 unchanged, P95 down ~8ms, CPU up ~3% on the runtime side. looks ok but i'll run the longer 1h stability job and post numbers.

ben: heads-up — CI flaky test `integration/grpc_reconnect` failed once locally, pushed a small retry fix to the branch, rerunning pipelines.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #42816.2 started — unit tests, lint, integration (macos/linux), loadtest smoke

raj: i'll spin up a couple of prod-like nodes in a canary pool tomorrow and run kernel/eviction stress. expecting results by EOD. if i see memory thrash i'll ask to pause the rollout.

tasha: ok after seeing the added test and the threat note i'm comfortable with conditional approval. one caveat: ensure we log the auth header decision in access logs for first 24h of rollout.

mira: posted the 1h stability job results — no regressions, 200k tokens/min sustained, P95 stable. screenshots: https://img.internal/shot123.png

ben: CI is green on retry, LGTM from my side (non-security).

jong: platform side is good, fallback behavior verified locally. recommend 10% slice then 50% after 1h with metrics check.

alex: great — thanks everyone. next steps: merge after two code approvals + security note satisfied + green CI. i'll open the rollout ticket and schedule Tue 09:00 PT. i'll post status in this thread when we start. :thumbsup:
